title: Jiki da hankali
description: Ten short stories about the body and the mind: a young boxer's vow and his father's belt in Kano, a weaned toddler's heavy breathing in Zaria, a grandfather who calms an angry student in Katsina, a court in Kaduna that weighs a mentally ill man's case, a smoker in Jos who gives up cigarettes for tea, a walk through the bush near Bauchi, a matron who cleans up a boarding school in Potiskum, a grandmother's Arabic course in Kano, two medical students among Egyptian mummies in London, and a false rumour that sets off a riot in Niamey.

lessons.title: Ɗamarar Abdulhalim
lessons.summary: In Kano, the young boxer Abdulhalim trains at dawn, vows before his teacher not to fear a famous boxer from Katsina, wears his father's old belt at the Sallah contest, wins through pain, and a doctor presses his hand and cools it with frozen water.
lessons.text:
Abdulhalim saurayi ne ɗan shekara ashirin da biyu. Yana zaune a unguwar Dorayi a Kano tare da iyayensa. Tun yana yaro yake son dambe, wasan gargajiya da Hausawa suka daɗe suna yi. Mahaifinsa ma ya yi dambe a lokacin da yake matashi, kuma har yanzu yana ba da labarin wasanninsa.

Kowace rana Abdulhalim yakan tashi da asuba. Bayan ya yi sallar asuba a masallacin unguwarsu, sai ya yi gudu a kan titi kafin rana ta fito. Iska tana da sanyi a lokacin asuba, kuma titi babu kowa. Malaminsa, Malam Ɗanyaro, yakan ce masa, "Ɗan dambe yana buƙatar tauri. Amma tauri ba a jiki kaɗai yake ba. Tauri na gaskiya yana cikin zuciya."

Wata rana Malam Ɗanyaro ya kawo masa labari. Za a yi babbar gasar dambe a lokacin Sallah, kuma Abdulhalim zai fafata da wani shahararren ɗan dambe daga Katsina mai suna Ɗangiwa. Abdulhalim ya ji tsoro kaɗan, amma ya sha alwashi a gaban malaminsa. Ya ce, "Na sha alwashi cewa ba zan ji tsoron Ɗangiwa ba. Zan yi iya ƙoƙarina." Malam Ɗanyaro ya yi murmushi ya ce, "Alwashi abu ne mai nauyi. Ka cika shi."

Ranar gasar, mutane da yawa sun taru a filin wasa. Kafin ya shiga fili, mahaifinsa ya ba shi wata tsohuwar ɗamara ta fata. Ya ce masa, "Wannan ɗamara tawa ce. Na ɗaura ta a wasana na ƙarshe shekaru talatin da suka wuce. Yau ba tawa ba ce kuma, taka ce." Abdulhalim ya ɗaura ɗamarar a jikinsa, sannan ya shiga fili.

Da aka fara wasan, Ɗangiwa ya tunkari Abdulhalim da sauri. Abdulhalim bai gudu ba. Shi ma ya tunkare shi. Sai Ɗangiwa ya buge hannun Abdulhalim na hagu da ƙarfi. Abdulhalim ya ji azaba mai tsanani. Azabar ta ratsa hannunsa har zuwa kafaɗa. Amma ya tuna maganar malaminsa game da tauri, sai ya ci gaba. A zagaye na uku, ya tunkari Ɗangiwa sau ɗaya kuma, ya buge shi a ƙirji, sai Ɗangiwa ya faɗi. Mutane suka yi ihu suna murna.

Bayan wasan, hannun Abdulhalim ya yi ja, kuma yana masa ciwo sosai. Wani likita da ke filin ya latsa hannun a hankali. Duk inda ya latsa, Abdulhalim yana jin azaba. Likitan ya ce, "Ƙashinka bai karye ba." Sai ya ɗauko ruwan da ya daskare a cikin leda, ya ɗora a kan hannun. Ya ce, "Ka riƙa ɗora ruwan da ya daskare a kan hannunka sau uku a rana. Kada ka latsa shi da kanka."

Da dare, Abdulhalim ya cire ɗamarar ya miƙa wa mahaifinsa. Mahaifinsa ya ƙi karɓa. Ya ce, "Ka cika alwashinka. Ka riƙe ta."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Abdulhalim yakan tashi?
Yakan tashi da asuba, ya yi sallah, sannan ya yi gudu.
Wane alwashi Abdulhalim ya sha?
Ya sha alwashi cewa ba zai ji tsoron Ɗangiwa ba.
Ta wa ce ɗamarar da Abdulhalim ya ɗaura?
Ta mahaifinsa ce. Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Wannan ɗamara tawa ce."
Me ya faru da Ɗangiwa ya tunkari Abdulhalim?
Ya buge hannunsa na hagu, sai Abdulhalim ya ji azaba mai tsanani.
Me likitan ya yi da hannun Abdulhalim?
Ya latsa hannun a hankali, sannan ya ɗora ruwan da ya daskare a kai.

lessons.title: Nishin Nuriyya
lessons.summary: In Zaria, Safinatu has weaned her two-year-old daughter Nuriyya, who now breathes heavily at night; a doctor has the girl open her mouth, asks about the home, finds that the powder and incense in her room are to blame, and advises fresh air.
lessons.text:
Safinatu tana zaune a Zaria tare da mijinta da 'yarsu Nuriyya, wadda take da shekara biyu. Wata biyu da suka wuce, Safinatu ta yaye Nuriyya. Yaye yaro ba abu ne mai sauƙi ba. A kwanakin farko, Nuriyya takan yi kuka da dare tana neman nono. Amma bayan mako guda ta saba, ta fara cin abinci kamar sauran yara.

Bayan an yaye ta, Safinatu ta lura da wani abu da ya ba ta tsoro. Da dare, idan Nuriyya tana barci, takan yi nishi. Nishin yana da ƙarfi, kamar na wanda yake ɗaukar kaya mai nauyi. Wani lokaci takan farka tana tari. Safinatu ta damu ainun. Ta ce wa mijinta, "Ina jin tsoro ainun. Ka ji nishin da take yi?"

Washegari da safe, kafin su ci karin kumallo, Safinatu ta ɗauki Nuriyya zuwa asibitin yara. Ba ta ba ta karin kumallo ba, domin ta yi tunanin likita zai so ya duba cikinta. Likitan, Malam Abdulmannan, ya tambaye ta, "Yaushe kika yaye ta?" Ta ce, "Wata biyu ke nan." Ya ce, "Takan ci abinci da kyau?" Ta ce, "Eh, takan ci da kyau. Amma da dare takan yi nishi, kuma takan yi tari."

Likitan ya sa Nuriyya a kan gado. Ya ce mata, "Ha! Buɗe bakinki. Ha!" Yarinyar ta buɗe baki, sai ya duba cikin bakinta da wata ƙaramar fitila. Ya ce, "Ha, sake buɗe shi!" Ya duba hancinta, sannan ya saurari ƙirjinta. Bai ga wata cuta ba.

Sai ya tambayi Safinatu game da gidansu. "A ɗakin da take barci, kina amfani da hoda ko turare?" Safinatu ta ce, "Eh. Bayan na yi mata wanka da yamma, nakan shafa mata hoda da yawa. Kuma da dare nakan kunna turare a ɗakin domin ƙamshi." Likitan ya girgiza kai. Ya ce, "Hayaƙin turaren da garin hodar suna shiga hancinta da huhunta. Shi ya sa take nishi."

Likitan ya shawarci Safinatu ta daina kunna turare a ɗakin yarinyar, kuma ta rage hoda. Ya kuma shawarce ta ta riƙa buɗe taga da rana domin iska mai kyau ta shiga ɗakin.

Safinatu ta bi shawararsa. Ta kai turaren falo, ta ajiye hodar a cikin akwati. Bayan mako guda, Nuriyya ta daina nishi. Takan yi barci har safe ba tare da tari ba. Washegari, Safinatu da mijinta da Nuriyya suka ci karin kumallo tare cikin farin ciki.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Safinatu ta yaye Nuriyya?
Ta yaye ta wata biyu da suka wuce.
Me Nuriyya takan yi da dare?
Takan yi nishi da dare, kuma wani lokaci takan yi tari.
Me ya sa Safinatu ba ta ba Nuriyya karin kumallo ba?
Domin ta yi tunanin likita zai so ya duba cikinta.
Me likitan ya ce wa Nuriyya kafin ya duba bakinta?
Ya ce mata, "Ha! Buɗe bakinki."
Me ya sa Nuriyya take nishi?
Saboda hayaƙin turare da garin hoda suna shiga hancinta da huhunta.
Me likitan ya shawarci Safinatu ta yi?
Ya shawarce ta ta daina kunna turare a ɗakin, ta rage hoda, kuma ta riƙa buɗe taga.

lessons.title: Gardamar abokai biyu
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the student Zainulabidin loses his temper in a political argument about socialism with his friend Nabil; his grandfather teaches him that anger comes from Satan, that good manners and virtue show in patience, and to pray two units when angry; the friends argue again calmly.
lessons.text:
Zainulabidin ɗalibi ne a jami'a a Katsina. Yana da hazaka, amma yana da saurin fushi. Abokinsa na kusa shi ne Nabil. Suna karatu tare, suna cin abinci tare, kuma sukan yi gardama game da siyasa.

Zainulabidin yana son tsarin gurguzu. Yana cewa, "A tsarin gurguzu, arzikin ƙasa na kowa ne. Babu attajiri, babu talaka." Amma Nabil ba ya son gurguzu. Yana cewa, "Gurguzu ba zai yi aiki ba. Mutum yana buƙatar ya yi aiki domin kansa." Wata rana da yamma, suna zaune a ƙofar gidan kakan Zainulabidin, sai gardamarsu ta yi zafi. Zainulabidin ya ce, "Maganarka tsantsar wauta ce!" Nabil shi ma ya ce, "Kai ne kake magana tsantsar jahilci!" Zainulabidin ya tashi tsaye, ya ɗaga hannunsa kamar zai buge abokinsa.

A daidai lokacin, kakansa ya fito daga cikin gida. Ya ce, "Ku daina!" Sannan ya ce, "Ina wuni?" Suka ce, "Lafiya lau." Kakan ya ce, "Ban ji daɗin wunin da kuka yi ba, idan haka kuke yin gardama."

Ya zauna kusa da su. Ya ce wa Zainulabidin, "Ka san fushi daga shaiɗan yake? Idan shaiɗan ya ga abokai biyu suna gardama, sai ya ƙara wa zuciyarsu zafi. Abin da shaiɗan yake so ke nan." Ya ci gaba, "Idan fushi ya kama ka, ka zauna. Idan bai tafi ba, ka yi alwala, ka yi sallah raka'a biyu. Ba za ka gama raka'a ta biyu ba sai fushin ya tafi."

Kakan ya kuma yi musu magana game da ɗa'a. Ya ce, "Ɗa'a ita ce ado na mutum. Kuna iya yin gardama, amma da ɗa'a. Ku saurari juna, kada ku yi wa juna zagi." Ya ce, "Nagartar mutum ba a cikin iliminsa kaɗai take ba. Nagarta tana cikin haƙurinsa da kuma ɗa'arsa."

Zainulabidin ya sunkuyar da kai. Ya ce wa Nabil, "Ka gafarta mini. Na yi kuskure." Nabil ya ce, "Ni ma ka gafarta mini." Kakan ya ce, "Alhamdulillahi."

Washegari, Zainulabidin ya yi sallah raka'a biyu bayan ya tashi, sannan ya je gidan Nabil. Ya ce, "Ina wuni?" Nabil ya ce, "Alhamdulillahi." Suka sake yin gardama game da gurguzu, amma wannan karo cikin natsuwa, kowa yana sauraren ɗan'uwansa. Har yanzu ba su yarda da juna ba, amma sun yi dariya tare.

Tambayoyi:
Me Zainulabidin da Nabil sukan yi gardama a kai?
Sukan yi gardama game da siyasa, musamman game da tsarin gurguzu.
Me Zainulabidin ya ce game da maganar Nabil?
Ya ce maganar Nabil tsantsar wauta ce.
Me Zainulabidin ya kusa yi a lokacin da gardamar ta yi zafi?
Ya ɗaga hannunsa kamar zai buge abokinsa.
Me kakan ya ce game da fushi?
Ya ce fushi daga shaiɗan yake, kuma idan fushi ya kama mutum, ya yi sallah raka'a biyu.
A ina kakan ya ce nagartar mutum take?
Ya ce nagarta tana cikin haƙurin mutum da ɗa'arsa.
Me kakan ya ce da abokan suka gafarta wa juna?
Ya ce, "Alhamdulillahi."
Yaya suka yi gardama washegari?
Sun yi gardama cikin natsuwa, kowa yana sauraren ɗan'uwansa.

lessons.title: A gaban kuliya
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Mujtaba, a man with a mental illness, is arrested on suspicion of the cruel killing of a tea seller; his sister's lawyer asks for bail, the judge postpones the case so doctors can assess him, authentic evidence shows that other men did it, and the judge orders mercy and treatment.
lessons.text:
Mujtaba mutum ne ɗan shekara talatin, kuma yana zaune a Kaduna tare da 'yar'uwarsa Ramlatu. Shekaru biyar da suka wuce, Mujtaba ya kamu da taɓin hankali. Wani lokaci yakan yi magana shi kaɗai, kuma yakan yi yawo a kan titi har cikin dare. Ramlatu tana kula da shi, tana kai shi asibiti.

Wata rana da safe, aka sami gawar wani mai sayar da shayi a bayan kasuwa. Wasu mutane sun yi masa kisan gilla da dare. Wasu mutanen unguwa sun ce sun ga Mujtaba yana yawo kusa da kasuwar a daren. Sai 'yan sanda suka kama shi, suka zarge shi da kisan gillar.

Bayan mako guda, aka kai Mujtaba gaban kuliya. Ramlatu ta sami lauya, Malam Abdurrashid. A gaban kuliya, lauyan ya roƙi alƙali ya bayar da belin Mujtaba. Ya ce, "Ya mai shari'a, wanda nake karewa yana da taɓin hankali. Idan ya zauna a kurkuku ba tare da magani ba, cutarsa za ta ƙaru. Muna roƙon a bayar da belinsa domin 'yar'uwarsa ta kula da shi."

Alƙalin bai bayar da beli ba a ranar. Ya ce, "Zan jinkirta shari'ar da mako biyu. Ina so likitoci su kimanta hankalinsa tukuna. Idan sun kimanta shi, za su kawo mini rahoto." Ramlatu ta yi kuka, amma lauyan ya ce mata, "Ki yi haƙuri. Jinkirta shari'a ba laifi ba ne. Yana ba mu lokaci."

A cikin makonnin biyu, likitoci biyu sun kimanta hankalin Mujtaba. Sun ce taɓin hankalinsa gaskiya ne, kuma yana buƙatar magani a asibiti. Sun kuma ce, da ya fara shan sabon magani, ya sami sassauci. Ya fara barci da kyau, kuma ya daina magana shi kaɗai.

A lokaci guda, 'yan sanda sun ci gaba da bincike. Sun sami shaida sahihiya: wani mai shago ya ga wasu matasa uku suna gudu daga bayan kasuwar a daren, kuma suna ɗauke da kuɗin mai shayin. 'Yan sanda suka kama matasan, kuma suka amsa laifinsu.

Ranar da aka koma kuliya, lauyan ya kawo rahoton likitoci da shaidar sahihiya. Alƙalin ya karanta su, sannan ya ce, "Na yarda cewa wannan shaida sahihiya ce. Mujtaba ba shi da laifi." Ya ƙara da cewa, "Shari'a tana buƙatar jinƙai. Saboda jinƙai, ina umartar gwamnati ta biya kuɗin maganinsa a asibiti."

Ramlatu ta ji sassauci a zuciyarta. Ta gode wa lauyan da alƙalin, sannan ta riƙe hannun ɗan'uwanta, suka fita daga kuliya tare.

Tambayoyi:
Wace cuta Mujtaba yake da ita?
Yana da taɓin hankali tun shekaru biyar da suka wuce.
Me ya sa 'yan sanda suka kama Mujtaba?
Saboda mutane sun ce sun gan shi kusa da kasuwa a daren da aka yi kisan gilla.
Me lauyan ya roƙi alƙali a gaban kuliya?
Ya roƙi alƙali ya bayar da belin Mujtaba.
Me ya sa alƙalin ya jinkirta shari'ar?
Domin likitoci su kimanta hankalin Mujtaba, su kawo masa rahoto.
Wace shaida sahihiya 'yan sanda suka samu?
Wani mai shago ya ga wasu matasa uku suna gudu daga bayan kasuwa, ɗauke da kuɗin mai shayin.
Me Ramlatu ta ji a zuciyarta a ƙarshe?
Ta ji sassauci a zuciyarta.
Me alƙalin ya ce saboda jinƙai?
Ya umarci gwamnati ta biya kuɗin maganin Mujtaba a asibiti.

lessons.title: Sigarin ƙarshe
lessons.summary: In Jos, Abdulgafar, who has smoked for twenty years with his morning coffee, coughs more and more; a doctor warns him of the risk, he throws away his cigarettes, chews a little stick and drinks tea instead of coffee, and after three months his wife sees that it has lasted.
lessons.text:
Malam Abdulgafar yana da shekara hamsin, kuma yana zaune a Jos tare da matarsa Hassanatu. Ya fara shan taba tun yana da shekara talatin. Kowace safiya, kafin ya tafi aiki, yakan zauna a ƙofar gida, ya sha kofin gahwa, ya kuma sha sigari biyu. Ya ce wa matarsa, "Gahwa ba ta da daɗi sai da taba."

A lokacin sanyi na wannan shekara, tarinsa ya tsananta. Da farko yana tari da safe kaɗai, amma daga baya tarin ya tsananta har yakan yi tari da dare, ya kasa barci. Hassanatu ta ce, "Ka je asibiti, don Allah."

Likitan ya saurari ƙirjinsa, sannan ya ce, "Malam, kana cikin kasada. Taba tana lalata huhunka. Idan ka ci gaba da sha, kasadar kamuwa da babbar cuta tana ƙaruwa kowace rana. Sigari da makamancinta duka suna da illa." Abdulgafar ya tambaya, "Ko akwai wani abu makamancin sigari wanda ba shi da illa?" Likitan ya ce, "Babu. Hanya ɗaya ce kawai: ka daina."

Da Abdulgafar ya koma gida, ya ɗauki duk sigarin da ke ɗakinsa ya jefar da su a cikin bola. Ya ce wa Hassanatu, "Yau na jefar da taba. Ba zan sake sha ba." Hassanatu ta ce, "Allah ya taimake ka. Amma ina tsoron ba za ka iya ba."

Kwanakin farko sun yi masa wuya ainun. Duk lokacin da yake son sigari, hannunsa yakan nemi wani abu. Sai Hassanatu ta ba shi wani ɗan tsinke. Ta ce, "Idan kana son sigari, ka sa wannan tsinke a bakinka." Abdulgafar yakan tauna tsinken har sha'awar ta wuce. A aljihunsa kullum akwai tsinke uku ko huɗu.

Ya kuma lura cewa duk lokacin da ya sha gahwa, yana tunawa da taba. Sai ya daina gahwa da safe, ya fara shan ti. Hassanatu takan dafa masa ruwan ti da citta da safe. Ya ce, "Ti ba shi da ƙarfin gahwa, amma ba ya tuna mini da sigari."

Abokansa a wurin aiki sun ce, "Mun ga makamancin wannan a baya. Wannan abin ba zai dore ba. Bayan mako guda zai koma." Amma bayan wata uku, Abdulgafar bai sake taɓa sigari ba. Tarinsa ya ragu, kuma yana iya hawa tudu ba tare da gajiya ba. Hassanatu ta ce, "Yanzu na yarda. Abin ya dore." Abdulgafar ya yi murmushi, ya sa sabon tsinke a bakinsa, ya sha ti.

Tambayoyi:
Me Abdulgafar yakan yi kowace safiya kafin ya tafi aiki?
Yakan sha kofin gahwa, ya kuma sha sigari biyu.
Me ya faru da tarinsa a lokacin sanyi?
Tarinsa ya tsananta har yakan yi tari da dare.
Wace kasada likitan ya ce Abdulgafar yake ciki?
Ya ce taba tana lalata huhunsa, kuma kasadar kamuwa da babbar cuta tana ƙaruwa.
Me Abdulgafar ya yi da sigarin da ke ɗakinsa?
Ya jefar da su a cikin bola.
Me ya sa ya daina gahwa ya fara shan ti?
Domin duk lokacin da ya sha gahwa, yana tunawa da taba.
Me Hassanatu ta ce bayan wata uku?
Ta ce, "Yanzu na yarda. Abin ya dore."

lessons.title: Tafiya ta cikin jeji
lessons.summary: Near Bauchi, the nurse Bashira and her brother Abdulkabir walk through the bush to their grandfather's village for exercise; she shades her head with a malafa, they climb a rocky hill, she digs a thorn out of his foot by a stream, they find big footprints, and an old hunter with a spear comes along and walks them to the village.
lessons.text:
Bashira ma'aikaciyar jinya ce a Bauchi. Tana son motsa jiki, kuma tana cewa tafiya da ƙafa magani ce ga jiki da hankali. Wata Asabar, ta ce wa ƙanenta Abdulkabir, "Mu tafi ƙauyen kakanmu da ƙafa ta cikin jeji. Tafiyar kilomita goma ce kawai." Abdulkabir ya yarda, ko da yake bai saba da tafiya mai nisa ba.

Suka tashi da wuri. Hanyar ta ratsa cikin jeji, inda babu gidaje sai bishiyoyi da ciyawa. Da rana ta yi zafi, Bashira ta fitar da malafarta daga cikin jakarta. Ta kare kanta daga rana da malafa, ta ce wa Abdulkabir, "Ina malafarka?" Ya ce, "Na manta da ita a gida." Sai ta ba shi ruwa, ta ce, "Ka riƙa shan ruwa kaɗan kaɗan."

A tsakiyar jejin akwai wani tudu mai duwatsu. Sai da suka haura tudun kafin su ci gaba. Haurawar ta yi wuya. Abdulkabir yana numfashi da ƙarfi, amma Bashira ta ce, "Ka haura a hankali, ka sa ƙafarka a kan duwatsu masu ƙarfi." Da suka haura har saman tudun, suka ga ƙauyen kakansu daga nesa.

A gefen ɗaya na tudun akwai wani rafi. Ruwan rafin yana da tsabta da sanyi. Suka zauna a gefen rafin suka huta. A nan ne Abdulkabir ya ce, "Ƙafata tana ciwo." Bashira ta duba ƙafarsa, sai ta ga ƙaya ta shiga ciki. Ta fitar da allura daga jakarta, ta zaƙulo ƙayar a hankali. Bayan ta zaƙulo ta, ta wanke ƙafar da ruwan rafin, ta ɗaure ta da zane.

Da suka tashi, Abdulkabir ya ga wani abu a cikin taɓo a gefen rafin. "Duba, sawun wata dabba!" Sawun yana da girma, kuma akwai sawu da yawa a jere. Bashira ta ji tsoro kaɗan. Ta ce, "Ban san sawun wace dabba ba ne."

Suna cikin tsoro, sai suka ji wani yana tafe a bayansu. Wani tsoho ne, mai riƙe da mashi a hannunsa. Ya ce, "Kada ku ji tsoro. Ni ne Malam Ɗantsoho, mafarauci ne ni. Ina tafe daga gonata." Ya duba sawun, ya yi dariya. Ya ce, "Wannan sawun shanu ne. Makiyaya sun wuce nan da safe." Ya nuna musu mashinsa, ya ce, "Ina ɗaukar mashi ne saboda macizai, ba saboda shanu ba."

Malam Ɗantsoho ya bi su har ƙauyen kakansu. Da suka isa, Abdulkabir ya ce, "Na gaji, amma jikina yana jin daɗi." Bashira ta yi murmushi.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Bashira ta so su yi tafiya ta cikin jeji?
Domin tana cewa tafiya da ƙafa magani ce ga jiki da hankali.
Da me Bashira ta kare kanta daga rana?
Ta kare kanta daga rana da malafa.
Me Bashira ta yi da ƙayar da ta shiga ƙafar Abdulkabir?
Ta zaƙulo ta da allura a gefen rafi.
Sawun wace dabba suka gani a gefen rafin?
Sawun shanu ne.
Daga ina Malam Ɗantsoho yake tafe?
Yana tafe daga gonarsa.
Me ya sa Malam Ɗantsoho yake ɗaukar mashi?
Yana ɗaukar mashi ne saboda macizai.

lessons.title: Tsaftar makarantar kwana
lessons.summary: At a girls' boarding school in Potiskum, the new matron Raudha finds that the students' stomach illness comes from filth in the toilets, the kitchen and the corners of the compound; she outlines a plan, the girls hold a communal cleaning day, and her strict new rules make the illness rare.
lessons.text:
Malama Raudha ta fara aiki a matsayin uwar ɗakin kwana a wata makarantar 'yan mata a Potiskum. A makon farko, 'yan mata da yawa sun zo wurinta da ciwon ciki. Wasu suna amai, wasu suna gudawa. Raudha ta ce, "Dole ne mu nemi tushen wannan cuta."

Ta zagaya makarantar gaba ɗaya. Da farko ta je banɗakin 'yan mata. Banɗakin ya cika da ƙazanta: babu ruwa, kuma ƙofofin ba sa rufewa. Ta ce, "Ba za a iya amfani da wannan banɗaki ba." Sannan ta je kicin, inda ake dafa abinci. Kicin ɗin ma yana cike da ƙazanta. Ƙudaje suna yawo a kan abinci, kuma tukwane ba a wanke su da kyau ba. Ta tambayi masu girki, "Kuna wanke hannu kafin ku dafa abinci?" Suka ce, "Ba kasafai muke wanke hannu ba, saboda babu sabulu."

Daga nan ta bi lungu da lungu na harabar makarantar. A kowane lungu akwai bola, ruwa marar kyau da ƙazanta. Ta ce, "Ƙazanta ce ke kawo cuta. Ba za mu bar ta ba."

Washegari, Raudha ta kira taron 'yan mata da malamai. Ta zayyana musu shirinta mataki mataki. Ta ce, "Na farko, za a riƙa wanke banɗakuna sau biyu a rana. Na biyu, ba za a dafa abinci a kicin ba sai an wanke hannu da sabulu. Na uku, za mu share kowane lungu na makaranta." Bayan ta zayyana shirin, ta ce, "Ranar Asabar za mu yi gayya. Kowa zai zo da tsintsiya."

Ranar Asabar, 'yan mata ɗari biyu sun fito gayya. Suka share lungunan harabar, suka ƙone bola, suka wanke banɗakuna da kicin. Malamai ma sun shiga gayyar. Har yamma suna aiki, suna waƙa.

Bayan gayyar, Raudha ta kafa sababbin dokoki, kuma ta bi su da tsauri. Duk 'yar da ta bar ƙazanta a ɗakinta, sai ta share banɗaki har kwana uku. Wasu 'yan mata sun ce, "Wannan tsauri ya yi yawa." Amma Raudha ta ce, "Tsaurin nan domin lafiyarku ne."

Bayan wata ɗaya, ba kasafai ake samun ciwon ciki a makarantar ba. Ba kasafai ake ganin 'yar da take amai ko gudawa ba. Shugabar makarantar ta gode wa Raudha a gaban kowa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya kawo wa 'yan mata ciwon ciki?
Ƙazanta ce a banɗakuna, a kicin da kuma a lungunan makaranta.
Me masu girki suka ce game da wanke hannu?
Sun ce ba kasafai suke wanke hannu ba, saboda babu sabulu.
Me Raudha ta zayyana a taron?
Ta zayyana shirinta: wanke banɗakuna, wanke hannu da sabulu, da share kowane lungu.
Me 'yan mata suka yi ranar Asabar?
Sun yi gayya: sun share lungunan harabar, sun wanke banɗakuna da kicin.
Me ya sa Raudha ta bi dokokin da tsauri?
Domin lafiyar 'yan mata.

lessons.title: Kwas na Larabci
lessons.summary: In Kano, the retired teacher Hajiya Ruwaida, sixty-five, fears for her memory, so she joins an Arabic course taught by an Arab from Sudan; she listens to cassettes, repeats sentences, works on her pronunciation, sings the chorus of a song, and finally writes a short poem of her own.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Ruwaida tana da shekara sittin da biyar, kuma ta yi ritaya daga aikin koyarwa a Kano. Wata rana ta manta da sunan maƙwabciyarta, sannan ta manta inda ta ajiye makullin gidanta. Ta damu, ta je wurin likita. Likitan ya ce, "Ƙwaƙwalwa kamar tsoka take. Idan ba ki yi amfani da ita ba, takan yi rauni. Ki koyi wani sabon abu."

Hajiya Ruwaida ta tuna da ƙuruciyarta. A lokacin ƙuruciya, tana son ta koyi Larabci sosai, amma ba ta sami dama ba, saboda ta yi aure da wuri. Sai ta ce, "Yanzu ne lokacin." Ta shiga wani kwas na Larabci a wata cibiya kusa da gidanta. Kwas ɗin yana ɗaukar wata shida, kuma ana zuwa sau uku a mako.

Malamin kwas ɗin balarabe ne daga Sudan, mai suna Malam Hisham. Ya daɗe a Kano, don haka yana jin Hausa sosai. Balaraben yakan ce wa ɗalibansa, "Nasararku ta ta'allaka ne ga maimaitawa. Ba ta ta'allaka ga shekarunku ba."

Malam Hisham ya ba kowane ɗalibi kaset guda uku. A cikin kaset ɗin akwai jumloli masu sauƙi da ya karanta da muryarsa. Hajiya Ruwaida takan saurari kaset ɗin kowace safiya. Takan dakatar da kaset bayan kowace jumla, sannan ta maimaita jumlar da ƙarfi. Wasu jumloli sun yi mata wuya, amma ba ta gaji ba.

Abu mafi wuya a gare ta shi ne furuci. Akwai sautukan Larabci da babu su a Hausa. Malam Hisham yakan ce, "Hajiya, furucinki ya kusa daidai. Ki buɗe makogwaronki kaɗan." Da sannu furucinta ya gyaru.

A ƙarshen kowane darasi, Malam Hisham yakan koya musu wata waƙa. Shi ne yake rera waƙar, ɗalibai kuma suna yin amshi. Hajiya Ruwaida tana son amshin sosai. Tana rera amshin a gida yayin da take girki, har jikokinta suka koya.

Bayan wata biyar, Malam Hisham ya ce kowane ɗalibi ya rubuta 'yar gajeriyar waƙa a Larabci. Hajiya Ruwaida ta yi kwana biyu ba ta san me za ta rubuta ba. Sai da dare, wahayi ya zo mata: ta rubuta game da ƙuruciyarta da mahaifiyarta. Ta ce wa malamin, "Ban san daga ina wannan wahayi ya zo ba." Malam Hisham ya ce, "Wahayi yakan zo wa wanda ya yi aiki tuƙuru."

Da kwas ɗin ya ƙare, Hajiya Ruwaida ta karanta waƙarta a gaban kowa. Ta ce, "Yanzu ba na mantuwa kamar a baya."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Hajiya Ruwaida ta je wurin likita?
Saboda ta manta da sunan maƙwabciyarta da inda ta ajiye makullinta.
Me take so ta yi a lokacin ƙuruciyarta?
Tana son ta koyi Larabci, amma ba ta sami dama ba.
Wane ne malamin kwas ɗin?
Malam Hisham ne, balarabe daga Sudan.
Me take yi da kaset ɗin kowace safiya?
Takan saurare su, ta dakatar da kaset bayan kowace jumla, sannan ta maimaita jumlar.
Malam Hisham ya ce nasarar ɗalibai ta ta'allaka ga me?
Ya ce nasararsu ta ta'allaka ne ga maimaitawa.
Wane abu ne ya fi yi mata wuya?
Furuci ne ya fi yi mata wuya.
Yaushe wahayi ya zo mata?
Wahayi ya zo mata da dare, sai ta rubuta game da ƙuruciyarta da mahaifiyarta.

lessons.title: Gawawwakin Masar a Landan
lessons.summary: In London, the Hausa medical student Fati accompanies her Japanese classmate Yuki to a museum; Yuki has only yen and changes it to pounds, Fati thinks of naira and kobo, they see Egyptian mummies and statues of the old gods, learn that the Egyptians thought the mind lived in the heart, and end the day at the cinema.
lessons.text:
Fati 'yar Najeriya ce da take karatun likitanci a Landan. A ajinsu akwai wata 'yar Japan mai suna Yuki. Wata Asabar, Yuki ta ce, "Fati, ki raka ni gidan tarihi. Ina so in ga gawawwakin Masar na zamanin da, domin muna karatun jikin ɗan Adam." Fati ta ce, "To, zan raka ki."

Kafin su shiga, Yuki ta duba jakarta. Ta ce, "Kai! Ba ni da fam ko ɗaya. Kuɗin Japan ne kaɗai a jakata, yen." Akwai wani shago kusa da ƙofa inda ake canza kuɗi. Yuki ta ba da yen dubu goma, aka ba ta fam hamsin. Fati ta yi dariya, ta ce, "A ƙasarmu kuma, muna da naira da kwabo. Kwabo ɗari ne naira ɗaya, amma yanzu babu wanda yake amfani da kwabo." Ta tuna da kakarta, wadda takan ce, "A lokacin ƙuruciyata, da kwabo biyar za ka sayi abinci."

A ciki, Yuki ta fitar da kyamararta. Ta ɗauki hotunan gawawwakin Masar da kyamarar. An naɗe gawawwakin da zane, kuma an ajiye su a cikin akwatuna masu ado. Kusa da wata gawa akwai rubutu da ya ce tsawon mutumin inci sittin ne kawai. Fati ta lissafa, ta ce, "Inci sittin bai kai tsawona ba. Mutanen zamanin da ba su da tsawo sosai."

Daga nan suka shiga wani ɗaki inda aka ajiye gumakan alloli na Masar a zamanin da. Wasu alloli suna da kan tsuntsu, wasu kuma kan dabba. Gumakan suna tsaye a cikin wata babbar da'ira, kuma a tsakiyar da'irar akwai wani dutse mai rubutu. Yuki ta ɗauki hoton da'irar da kyamararta. Ta ce, "Mutanen Masar suna da alloli da yawa. Kowanne daga cikin allolin yana da nasa aiki."

Wani ma'aikacin gidan tarihin ya zo ya yi musu bayani. Ya ce, "Mutanen Masar na zamanin da sun yarda cewa hankalin mutum yana cikin zuciyarsa, ba a kansa ba. Saboda haka sukan ajiye zuciyar mamaci a cikin jikinsa, domin su yarda alloli za su auna ta a lahira." Fati ta ce wa Yuki, "Yau mun san cewa ƙwaƙwalwa ce wurin hankali. Amma har yanzu a Hausa muna cewa zuciya tana tunani."

Da yamma, Yuki ta ce, "Kin raka ni gidan tarihi, yanzu ni zan raka ki sinima. Ni zan biya." Suka je wata sinima kusa da gidan tarihin. Tikitin sinima fam goma ne. Yuki ta biya da fam ɗin da ta canza daga yen.

Da suka fito daga sinima, Fati ta ce, "Yau na koyi abubuwa da yawa game da jiki da hankali." Yuki ta nuna mata hotunan da ta ɗauka da kyamararta.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Yuki ta ce Fati ta raka ta?
Ta ce ta raka ta gidan tarihi domin ta ga gawawwakin Masar.
Me ya sa Yuki ta canza kuɗi?
Domin ba ta da fam ko ɗaya, sai yen kaɗai.
Me Fati ta ce game da kwabo?
Ta ce kwabo ɗari ne naira ɗaya, amma yanzu babu wanda yake amfani da shi.
Inci nawa ne tsawon mutumin da ke cikin akwati?
Tsawonsa inci sittin ne.
Ina gumakan alloli suke tsaye?
Suna tsaye a cikin wata babbar da'ira.
A ina mutanen Masar na zamanin da suka yarda hankali yake?
Sun yarda cewa hankali yana cikin zuciya.

lessons.title: Labarin ƙarya a Niamey
lessons.summary: In Niamey, the brakes of the nurse Salamatou's car fail and she knocks a student, Mahamadou, off his motorbike; a false story that he has died spreads by phone and students start a riot, until an army officer arrives, escorts them to hospital, and the students find Mahamadou alive; afterwards people complain about those who spread lies.
lessons.text:
Salamatou ma'aikaciyar jinya ce a wani asibiti a Niamey, babban birnin Nijar. Wata rana da safe tana tuƙa motarta zuwa aiki. Da ta kusa wata makarantar sakandare, sai ta danna burki, amma burkin bai kama ba. Ta sake danna burki da ƙarfi, amma motar ba ta tsaya ba. Sai motar ta bugi wani ɗalibi da ke kan babur, mai suna Mahamadou. Ya faɗi a ƙasa, ƙafarsa tana zubar da jini.

Salamatou ta fito daga mota da sauri. Ta duba Mahamadou. Yana numfashi, kuma idanunsa a buɗe suke. Ta ɗaure ƙafarsa da zane, ta ce masa, "Kada ka ji tsoro. Ni ma'aikaciyar jinya ce."

Amma wasu mutanen da suke wucewa sun ɗauki hoto da wayoyinsu. Wani daga cikinsu ya yayata labarin ƙarya a waya cewa wata mace ta kashe ɗalibi da motarta. Cikin minti goma, mutane da yawa sun yayata labarin. Ɗalibai daga makarantar suka fito suna ihu. Suka fara tarzoma: suka jefa duwatsu, suka ƙone tayar mota a kan titi. Salamatou ta ji tsoro ainun.

A daidai lokacin, motar sojoji ta iso. Wani hafsan soja mai suna Kwamanda Issoufou ya fito. Hafsan ya ɗaga murya, ya ce, "Ku tsaya! Ku daina tarzoma!" Salamatou ta je wurinsa, ta ce, "Yallaɓai, burkin motata ne ya ƙi kamawa. Ɗalibin bai mutu ba. Yana buƙatar asibiti yanzu." Hafsan ya duba Mahamadou, sannan ya ce, "Kin faɗi gaskiya. Za mu ba ku rakiya zuwa asibiti."

Sojojin suka ba su rakiya har zuwa asibiti. Shugabannin ɗaliban biyu suka bi su. Da suka isa, suka iske likitoci suna jira a ƙofa, domin Salamatou ta kira su ta waya. Bayan awa guda, shugabannin ɗaliban suka shiga ɗakin, suka iske Mahamadou zaune a kan gado yana magana da mahaifiyarsa. Ƙafarsa kawai ta karye.

Shugabannin ɗaliban suka fita suka gaya wa sauran ɗalibai gaskiya. Tarzomar ta ƙare. Daga baya, mutane da yawa sun koka game da waɗanda suke yayata labaran ƙarya. Wani malami ya koka a rediyo, ya ce, "Labarin ƙarya yana iya kashe mutane fiye da hatsarin mota." Kwamanda Issoufou ya ce wa Salamatou, "Ki gyara burkin motarki kafin ki sake tuƙa ta." Ta ce, "Na gode, yallaɓai."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa motar Salamatou ba ta tsaya ba?
Domin burkin motar bai kama ba.
Wane labarin ƙarya aka yayata a waya?
An yayata cewa wata mace ta kashe ɗalibi da motarta.
Me Salamatou ta ce wa hafsan?
Ta ce, "Yallaɓai, burkin motata ne ya ƙi kamawa."
Me ɗaliban suka yi a lokacin tarzomar?
Sun jefa duwatsu, sun ƙone tayar mota a kan titi.
Wa ya ba su rakiya zuwa asibiti?
Sojoji ne a ƙarƙashin hafsan soja, Kwamanda Issoufou.
Yaya shugabannin ɗaliban suka iske Mahamadou a asibiti?
Sun iske shi zaune a kan gado yana magana da mahaifiyarsa.
Me mutane suka koka a kai daga baya?
Sun koka game da waɗanda suke yayata labaran ƙarya.
